scope: Gibraltar (pinned), empty-handed, movescale 1.15, spawned rock wall (face x ~ -13706, normal -X, top 532.836 = floor 294.92 + 237.9 standing height), approach from lane A at sprint 299 u/s. Sessions 20261020_221951_M3_wall_chain + 20261020_215746_M3_pilot (144 fps), 20261020_223838_M3_fps120 + 20261020_224455_M3_fps120_rerun (120 fps), 20261020_225255_M3_fps60 (60 fps); update 2: 20261020_233003_M3_late_hops120 (120 fps, late E7 presses + e8_hop350_d*) and 20261020_233547_M3_late60 (60 fps, late E7 presses); runner trials with ok=true and warmup=false only. Produced by wall_mantle_analysis.py (results.json, analysis_output.txt).
units: Source units (u), seconds (s), u/s, u/s^2. dt = usercmd frametime. z values marked 'abs' are world z on this map; floor = 294.92.

evidence_levels.measured: read directly from first-time client usercmds (dedi checked)
evidence_levels.fitted: parameter of a formula fitted to the usercmds; residual given
evidence_levels.bounded: never observed; only a lower/upper bound follows from the scored trials
evidence_levels.supplementary: from runner-rejected trials (frame rate outside +/-3 %) or from source; never used for a fitted value
evidence_levels.census: live class var read by the session census

approach_jump_distance.source: measured: climb-jump take-off x ~ -13808 vs face -13706
approach_jump_distance.note: schedule geometry, not a game parameter

contact_origin_offset_from_face.source: measured: contact usercmd post x -13723.13..-13723.32 vs face -13706

contact_horizontal.formula: afterwards the climb velocity lies along the face: vx/vz = 0.0324 (sd 0.0000) -> face leans 1.86 deg

contact_dvz.source: fitted over 3 fps: contact usercmd dvz = 6.98 (144), 6.46 (120), 3.33 (60)

climb_accel_up.formula: vz += a_up*dt while below the speed line; a single 490 keeps vz within ~1 u/s

climb_speed_line_k.source: fitted per trial after the peak: dvz/dt = -k*vz <=> vz = k*(Z0 - z)

climb_speed_line_Z0_abs.source: fitted intercept of vz_post vs z_post (zero-speed height); independent of the contact height
climb_speed_line_Z0_abs.note: = floor + 180.41 = ledge top - 57.5 on this wall; with one wall height the reference (floor, ledge, climbHeight) cannot be separated

climb_peak_vz.source: measured (where a_up meets the speed line)
climb_peak_vz.formula: consequence of contact vz, a_up and the line

climb_end_abs_z.source: bracket over all trials: climb ends on the first usercmd whose pre z >= thr; thr in (441.913, 441.934] (157 climbs incl. update 2; was (441.913, 441.949] over 100). Height above contact (95.1..96.9), time since contact (0.843..0.851 s) and vz (57.8..58.2) give no consistent threshold
climb_end_abs_z.note: = floor + 147.0 = ledge top - 90.9 on this wall. census climbHeight 100 is not reached here (climb gain 95.1..97.4 u); whether a taller wall stops at climbHeight is untested

climb_final_jump_dvz.compare: census climbFinalJumpUpHeight 28 -> sqrt(2*750*28) = 204.9 (dt->0 value is 1.5 % higher)

climb_final_outward_kick.source: fitted over 3 fps: post vx -64.62 (144), -63.92 (120), -59.75 (60) = -(68.1 - 500*dt); the 500*dt is air acceleration toward the held W

post_climb_air_phase.source: measured: 6-9 airborne usercmds between the final jump-up and the first traversal frame (144/120 fps)

mantle_traversal_duration.source: measured: gap in MOVE-TRACE (no FullWalkMove) between last pre-mantle and first post-mantle usercmd

spread.60: 0.546 sd 0.065 (4/24 late starts at +0.15 s with 0.467 s traversals)

mantle_traversal_from_anim.source: fitted on scored trials only (update 2): remaining time (MB-APPLY t - MB-TRIG t) = 0.588*(1 - anim) - 0.004, rms 0.011 s, n=89, anim 0.015..0.999
mantle_traversal_from_anim.superseded: 0.579 s from the earlier fit that needed rejected trials

mantle_exit_speed.source: measured first usercmd after the traversal; = MB-APPLY pose speed (GetPoseSpeed_Sprint with sprint held) x 1

mb_failed_exit_jump.source: MB-APPLY state 3 vel (299.0, 0, 289.8) on client and dedi; first post-traversal usercmd post vz = V - g*dt (284.61 / 283.57 / 277.30)
mb_failed_exit_jump.formula: h = 56 (= jumpHeight): exit v = (299 along move dir, V)

mb_boost_exit.source: measured, scored update-2 trials: first post-traversal usercmd v_h = 388.708 (120) / 388.715 (60), post vz = 361.16 (120, sd 0.03) / 354.905 (60) = V - g*dt; MB-APPLY state 4 vel (388.7, 0, 367.4) on both sides

mb_press_ignored_first_traversal_frame.source: measured: presses on the last pre-traversal usercmd or the first traversal frame (rel. start <= +1 frame) never produced MB-TRIG; from +2 frames on they always did (60: +16.7 ms ignored / +33 ms trig; 120: +8.3 ms ignored / +16.7 ms trig; 144: +13.9 ms trig)

mb_boost_window_scored.source: scored presses reached anim 0.131 (144, logged), 0.189 (120), 0.277 (60); 144 pilot (MB log off) presses up to +0.293 s into the traversal exited at 299 u/s (no boost)

bound.144: window starts later than traversal start + 0.293 s

mb_boost_window_estimate.source: supplementary: state 4 at anim 0.825/0.829/0.872 (delta 0.94/0.89/0.45 deg), state 3 'angle' at anim 0.499..0.661 (delta 4.96..3.19); delta < 1.5 deg crossed at anim ~0.78 (linear interpolation) -> window = T*(1 - 0.78) with T = 0.579 s
mb_boost_window_estimate.compare: source comment: sweet spot opens about the last 0.10-0.13 s
mb_boost_window_estimate.superseded_by: mb_boost_window_measured (update 2): measured last 16 frames @120 / 8 @60 = 133 ms, anim edge 0.770..0.796, inside this estimate (0.10..0.20 s, anim ~0.78)

wall_bounce_outward_O.source: fitted from none/back (dv_out = O + I = 257.865, n=23) and W held (dv_out + 500*dt = O - I = 107.702, n=50, 3 fps)

wall_bounce_input_dir_rule.value: normalised stick direction; zero stick -> wall normal
wall_bounce_input_dir_rule.source: back at half stick (fwd -0.5 on the press usercmd) = no input to 0.005 u/s

wall_bounce_up.value: vz kept: vz_post = vz_pre + U - g*dt/2, U = 3.5..5.3
wall_bounce_up.compare: census wallrunJumpUpSpeed 240 is NOT added and is not a floor (post vz 55..177)

wall_bounce_side_measured.unit: u/s (dv, moveright pressed on the jump usercmd, half stick)
wall_bounce_side_measured.note: the O/I model predicts 182.78 / 75.08; not explained (|dv| 226.6 at 51.5 deg from the normal). Use the measured vector for a pure side press

wall_bounce_timing_dependence.source: dv identical (< 0.03 u/s) at 0.15 s, 0.40 s and 0.62..0.87 s after contact

landing_overspeed_decel.source: measured: first ground usercmds after a 350 u/s landing with sprint + W held: -1249.2..-1250.9 per cmd down to 299 (5 cmds at 120, 6 at 144; 0.041 s)
landing_overspeed_decel.note: same value as the M2 no-input deceleration; the landing usercmd itself keeps the air speed; a jump on any of these commands ends at 299 instead (hop350)

landing_cap_clip.source: measured: every hop / drop landing at 299.06..300.45 is 299.000 after the first ground usercmd
landing_cap_clip.n: all E8 hop and drop landings (29 trials)

skip_speed_reduce.value: not observed as -100; jump clamps horizontal speed to 299
skip_speed_reduce.source: e8_hop350_d{0,1,2,3,5,10} x3 at 120 fps: first re-jump pre speed 350.17 (D0) / 339.74 (D1) / 329.32 (D2) / 318.89 (D3) / 299.00 (D5, D10) -> post 299.003 in every trial (sd 0); later re-jumps 299.06 -> 299.003. A -100 reduction would give 250. The data cannot separate min(v, 299) from max(v - 100, 299) for v < 399
skip_speed_reduce.formula: v_h(after ground jump) = min(v_h, sprint cap 299) (+ air accel)

landSlowdownDuration_effect.source: 232 u drop, impact vz -584..-590: 299.7 -> 299.0 on the first ground cmd, then 299.000 constant for the 0.72..0.74 s W + sprint stayed held

slide_resume_on_landing.value: slide continues, no boost, no extra loss
slide_resume_on_landing.source: measured: ducked landing at 350.21 -> slide flag on, first ground dv/dt -224.5 = -(100 + 0.3567*v) (M2 slide rule); second landing at 223..240 likewise (-184.5)

slide_jump_from_resumed_slide.source: measured: 2nd slide jump at 222.9..239.6 u/s leaves at the same speed (+0.008); 1st slide jump (fresh boosted slide) 315..318 -> 350.005
slide_jump_from_resumed_slide.note: M2's v = max(v, 350) holds only for the boosted slide; v = max(v, min(350, v + stored boost gain)) fits both, cannot be separated here

slide_jump_V_chain.source: measured V 239.3..242.1 = slideJumpHeight 50 with antiMultiJump frac 0.76..0.78 (M2 rule) in 9/10; r776 7 u/s above the rule

parity.value: contact, bounce and mantle exit identical; climb drifts
parity.source: client vs dedi MOVE-TRACE of the same usercmd: contact <= 0.001, mantle exit <= 0.014 (print precision), climb drift <= 0.13 u / 0.7 u/s, one trial (r760) did the final jump-up one usercmd apart; MB-TRIG anim/delta/state identical 37/37 pairs

mb_boost_window_measured.source: measured on dedi MB-TRIG (authoritative): 120 fps boost for N 196..212 (press 1..16 frames before the first post-traversal usercmd), state 3 'angle' for N <= 195 (>= 17 frames before), ordinary jump on top for N >= 213; 60 fps boost N 99..107 (1..8 frames before), state 3 N <= 98 (>= 9), jump on top N >= 108. Opening edge: anim 0.770 fail / 0.783 boost (120), 0.767 / 0.796 (60); delta 1.63 / 1.45 and 1.66 / 1.28 deg (threshold 1.5). Window runs to the last traversal frame (anim 0.99..0.999)

N_after_climb_jump.60: 99..107 (traversal start jitter +-1..2 frames; 60 fps late starts shift it)

mb_boost_window_144.source: lower bound only: no boost for presses up to +0.293 s into the traversal (pilot, MB log off) / anim 0.131 (logged). Prediction from the measured anim edge (0.777) and T 0.588 s: last ~0.131 s = ~19 frames, N ~236..255

mb_classic_input.source: jump+crouch (sg) vs jump only at the same N: 120 N195 both state 3, N200/205/210 both boost; 60 N101/104 both boost, N98 both state 3; identical exit velocities

mb_client_mispredict.source: r1318 (60 fps, press on the last traversal frame, anim 0.987, delta ~0): client gate 'dec' (delta -0.00 vs prev 0.01) -> state 3, dedi 'ok' -> state 4; client exits at 299/277 and is corrected to 388.7 three usercmds later

mb_lurch_after_boost.source: no strafe input in any E7 schedule; source says state 4 suppresses tap strafe until next traversal or landing (mantle_boost.cpp:116-121, mantle_boost_disables_tap_strafes)

hop_jump_height_penalty.source: all re-jumps (D 0..10 frames = 1..11 usercmds = 0.008..0.092 s after landing) V = 158.735 (sd 0.004) = 289.82*sqrt(0.3): M2 antiMultiJump hold (0.15 s) confirmed
